content:
ana: heads-up: product wants to start sunsetting implicit v1 routing (headerless requests auto-fallthrough). proposing: require explicit x-redwood-api-version header or ?api_version=v2 by GA. need consensus on console UX, telemetry tags, and quota mapping.
chris: can we get a short rationale to paste into the console hint?
ana: short: 'We’re moving to explicit API versioning to improve routing predictability and enable safer rollouts.' longer rationale in doc link: https://redwood.internal/confluence/v1-sunset (draft).
leo: engineering note: runtime currently treats absent header as v1 for parity. switching breaks any client that relied on implicit behavior. We should add a runtime flag: implicit-fallback=disabled|allow-legacy and a graceful window.
maya: SRE concern: telemetry. we must tag both the request and the routing decision so we can count clients by implicit vs explicit. propose tags: route.api_version=(v1|v2|implicit-v1), telemetry.flag=implicit_fallback.
tom: +1 on tags. Also add metric: quota.legacy_token_use to understand billing impact. we should track token counts by version key.
olga: for console UX: show a per-organization banner when we detect >0.5% implicit traffic for 7d. Banner text: 'We detected legacy API usage. Recommend adding x-redwood-api-version to requests. Click to open migration guide.' Add a per-org opt-out and an action to trigger a 30d migration grace window.
rachel: product asks that the default migration grace be 90d for enterprise customers with support contact. non-enterprise 30d. also want a canary toggle in console to flip implicit-fallback off for specific projects/orgs.
chris: rollout plan sketch: 1) telemetry + console banner (2 weeks) 2) opt-in console toggle per org (2 weeks) 3) soft-disable implicit-fallback for 5% sample traffic (4 weeks) 4) increase to 25% (2 weeks) 5) disable globally after 90d for enterprise/30d others. needs QA and legal signoff for billing behavior.
leo: runtime changes: a) route selection: prefer header/query param, b) if absent and implicit-fallback enabled, mark request as implicit-v1 in telemetry, c) when implicit is disabled, reject with 412 + migration hint. sample response: ```http
HTTP/1.1 412 Precondition Failed
Content-Type: application/json
{ "error": "API version required", "hint": "Add header: x-redwood-api-version: v2 or use ?api_version=v2. See: https://redwood.internal/migrate" }
```
nana: what about quota mapping? historically v1 and v2 token math differs (v2 counts sub-tokens differently). We need a deterministic mapping so customers don't get surprised. proposal: during grace, bill using the version resolved by runtime (implicit-v1 mapped to legacy token multiplier 1.0). After final cutover, implicit requests rejected.
tom: telemetry will emit two streams: billing.tokens.{v1,v2} with labels org_id and routing_mode=(explicit,implicit). We'll add a dashboard tile showing weekly token delta per org.
maya: SLO/liveness: when we start sampled disable we need fallback model variants. for some customers v1->v2 mapping might route to smaller/quantized model and affect latency. Add a canary with 100 orgs to detect regressions.
chris: console action items: - banner copy - per-org toggle UI - canary cohort selector - migration FAQ link - automated email template to org admins. olga will own banner and toggle copy, rachel owns FAQ and email.
olga: will mock banner today, posting screenshot in #eng-design later.
nana: API surface compatibility: do we permit query param ?api_version=v2 for SDKs that can't set headers? yes, but mark query param usage in telemetry as explicit. also add small note: 'query params logged in URLs' so we shouldn't recommend secrets.
leo: implement a short-circuit check in router: ```py
def resolve_version(req):
  if req.headers.get('x-redwood-api-version'):
    return ('v2','explicit')
  if req.query.get('api_version'):
    return (req.query['api_version'],'explicit')
  return ('v1','implicit')
```
chris: testing plan: integration test for header precedence, telemetry tagging, quota calc. add e2e scenario that simulates a client that never sets header.
tom: dashboard: new panel 'Implicit clients' with top 50 orgs by implicit token spend, weekly trend, and a link to open migration ticket.
maya: incident play: if we see a sudden drop in v2 explicit traffic during rollout step, auto-rotate rollback policy to re-enable implicit-fallback and send page to eng-oncall.
nana: legal/billing: will billing team be OK with doing dual-rate counting during grace? otherwise customers might see spikes. rachel to sync with billing.
rachel: will sync, prefer to surface 'expected change' in console billing preview. also want a migration checklist that hits support before cutting.
chris: timeline request: can eng teams commit to initial telemetry + banner in 10 business days?
leo: yes for runtime telemetry tag and reject message change, depends on QA slot.
olga: design mockups by EOD Friday.
tom: I'll prep the dashboard query and a lightweight alert rule.
dev-bot: deploy: telemetry-feature-flag toggles merged to staging at 2026-06-12T09:02:12Z :white_check_mark:
nana: thanks all. I'll draft a short RFC with the plan and add owners + dates. if anyone objects to aggressive default windows (30/90) reply here now.
chris: :thumbsup:
leo: :+1:
